bio_en: Hambardzum Aghajanian, known as Karo, was born in Astrakhan in 1877, the son of a tailor, and trained as a carpenter at the Armenian craft school there, graduating in 1893. In 1895 he became a sailor on the Caspian and moved to Baku. In April 1897 he was sent to Salmast with Mkrtich Sultaniants and Astvatsatur Mirzayan (Kretatsi), and lost both comrades in the fighting there. From 1904 he devoted himself entirely to party work in Baku, and in 1907 he was charged with organising the assassination of Mihran of Baberd and his associates; in prison he concealed his real name under the alias Karapet Avagian.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Fate after imprisonment not read (Droshak Nov-Dec 1908 article). Different person from Karo = Aristakes Zorian.
